annotations.title: Split text into a thread that fits (X, Bluesky, Farcaster, Mastodon, Threads)

description: Split long text into a thread where every post fits the network's limit, counted the way that network counts. X: weighted, CJK and emoji count 2, every link 23, limit 280. Bluesky: 300 graphemes and 3000 bytes. Farcaster: UTF-8 bytes, 320 per cast (1024 long cast). Mastodon: 500, links 23. Threads (Meta): 500, emoji count as their UTF-8 bytes. Breaks at paragraph, sentence, clause, then word boundaries (CJK-aware), never inside a URL or @mention, adds n/N numbering that is included in the count, and re-checks every post. Returns posts with their lengths. Pure computation. PAID: $0.002 per call in USDC on Base via x402 over MCP, or from prepaid credits if this server is configured with an Authorization: Bearer tkc_... header (see payment_options).

limit.description: Optional max length per post in that network's unit; default is the network's own limit (see network_rules)

network.description: Target network: x (X/Twitter, default), bluesky, farcaster, mastodon or meta-threads (Threads by Meta)

numbering.description: Where to put "n/N": suffix (default), prefix or none; counted in each post's length

text.description: The text to split (any language, max 25000 characters)
